query.description: Search mode: the query this result was found for.

position.description: Search mode: rank of the result, starting from 1.

site_name.description: Search mode: domain of the result.

snippet.description: Search mode: text snippet from the result.
snippet.example: An overview of tools for automating work on the web.

date.description: Search mode: publication date. Present for news and some web results.

url.description: URL of the search result, or the URL that was asked to be fetched.

title.description: Title of the result or page.

final_url.description: Fetch mode: the URL after any redirects.

description.description: Fetch mode: the page's meta description.
description.example: A short description of the example article.

language.description: Fetch mode: detected language of the page.

author.description: Fetch mode: author from the page's meta tags.

published_date.description: Fetch mode: publication date of the page, when it can be detected.

text.description: Fetch mode: the page content. A string for the "markdown" and "html" formats, a document tree for "json".
text.example:
# Example Article Title

The first paragraph of the article.

links.description: Fetch mode: links found on the page, when `links` was requested.

image_links.description: Fetch mode: image URLs found on the page, when `image_links` was requested.

iframe_links.description: Fetch mode: iframe URLs found on the page, when `iframe_links` was requested.

latency_ms.description: Fetch mode: time taken to fetch and extract the page, in milliseconds.

error.description: Fetch mode: why this URL could not be fetched, such as `page_not_found`, `timeout` or `bot_blocked`. Absent for pages that were fetched. Failed URLs are not charged.

status.description: Fetch mode: HTTP status of the target, when a failed URL returned one.

pages.title: Fetched pages
pages.description: Pages that were read, and the URLs that failed.
